findings.current: the headless body of the EXP I’d just earned… No, the Lycanthrope Champion
findings.defect: Jin did not earn the EXP; Yamamoto took the final blow.
findings.rationale: The source calls the corpse EXP as a frustrated joke, without saying Jin received it.
findings.replacement: the headless body of the EXP… No, the Lycanthrope Champion
findings.source: 목이 잘린 채 쓰러진 경험치…… 아니, 라스칸스로프 챔피언의 시신

findings.current: Then, using Lightfoot, he bounded toward me and grinned.
findings.defect: The draft reverses who approaches: Jin uses lightfoot to approach the Skeleton King.
findings.rationale: 다가오는 나를 identifies Jin as the one approaching.
findings.replacement: Then he grinned at me as I approached using lightfoot.
findings.source: 경공을 펼쳐 다가오는 나를 보며 씩 웃었다.

findings.defect: The Skeleton King refers to Yamamoto in the third person rather than addressing him.
findings.rationale: 저 points to the person he has just spotted under Jin’s arm.

findings.current: Ignoring the Griffins rushing at me with their gale of magical power,
findings.defect: The draft makes multiple Griffins rush Jin here, although this attack is by their leader.
findings.rationale: The preceding identification and the subsequent overhead attack single out the leader; the source uses 그리핀들 for that named monster.
findings.replacement: Ignoring the Griffin leader rushing at me with its gale of magical power,
findings.source: 나는 마력의 돌풍과 함께 덮쳐오는 그리핀들을 무시한 채.

findings.current: the enormous mana rising from deep within it press down on the battlefield.
findings.defect: “Within it” makes the mana rise from the wind, a causal connection absent from the source.
findings.rationale: The source locates the rising mana deep within the scene, not inside the wind that has just died down.
findings.replacement: the enormous mana rising from somewhere deep below press down on the battlefield.
findings.source: 그사이 깊숙한 곳에서 솟아올라 전장을 짓누르는 거대한 마나를 느꼈다.

findings.defect: A System notice retains square brackets around the status name, contrary to the specified panel format.
findings.rationale: The framed System panel already distinguishes UI terms; the binding Markdown rule excludes square brackets there.

findings.defect: A second System notice retains square brackets around the status name.
findings.rationale: The binding Markdown rule calls for UI terms without square brackets inside System panels.

findings.current: An inferno engulfed hundreds—maybe a thousand—monsters and exploded.
findings.defect: The draft drops the established rendering of 겁화.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary fixes 겁화 as “hellfire.”
findings.replacement: Hellfire engulfed hundreds—maybe a thousand—monsters and exploded.
findings.source: 수백, 혹은 천에 달하는 몬스터들을 집어삼킨 겁화가 폭발했다.

summary: Several action and subject errors change who acts, what Jin gains, and how the aerial attack unfolds. There are also localized terminology and formatting issues.
